t: You're at the site of the Royal Northern Hospital on Holloway Road, near Tollington Way. It was a general hospital, with inpatient, outpatient and accident and emergency care, and a centre for postgraduate medical and nurse education. It was designed by Charles Holden, who is better known for London Underground stations and for Senate House. The writer A. E. Coppard died here. He was a largely self-taught author, admired for short stories, many with rural settings, and championed in his lifetime by Ford Madox Ford and Arnold Bennett.
